purpose: Verify local official registry/cadastre evidence and inspect anonymous public map HTML/static JS/schema and geometry-safe routes for city parcel coverage.
scopeLimits: Inspected the public DLRS map-search HTML and client script, queried only division/district/survey administrative selectors, and verified the Kishoreganj Sadar local land office. Did not request a plot/dag, khatian, owner, land area, legal identifier, or map feature record. The map’s separate Khatian-data endpoint is excluded.
assessment: The public DLRS map UI has an advertised GeoJSON sheet route and parcel vector-tile route after a survey/mouza selection. The district selector resolved Kishoreganj (`010400000`), but the corresponding public survey selector returned HTTP 200 with an empty list. No sheet or parcel tile can therefore be selected for Kishoreganj through this route without inventing codes. The owner/khatian detail endpoint was not called.
registryAssessment: The official Kishoreganj Sadar Upazila Land Office identifies the local land administration. The official DLRS site assigns Kishoreganj to its Mymensingh settlement zone, and DLRS Map Search exposes district, survey, upazila, mouza, and sheet selectors. Its public selector returned Kishoreganj district, but no survey options for that district.

Official DLRS zone information lists Kishoreganj under the Mymensingh Zonal Settlement Office. Search/open content was accessible; direct HTTPS verification to this host failed certificate validation and no HTTP status is claimed.

nextStep: Root review; no runtime source adapter or global registry/catalog change is justified by the verified geometry evidence.
